A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]], attaining the rank of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. Following the appointment of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lucien Draay]] to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] he was assigned to assist in moving Draay's belongings into his [[Lucien Draay's quarters|new apartment]] within the [[High Council Tower/Legends|High Council Tower]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Along with [[Unidentified Human Padawan 1 (Mandalorian War)|another Padawan]], they completed the assignment as Draay arrived to take up residence.<ref name="KOTOR31" />
